title: Does muscle turn into fat when you stop? 🔄
caption:
Muscle and fat are different tissues; one cannot turn into the other. When you stop, muscle slowly shrinks and, if you eat the same, fat goes up. And muscle comes back faster thanks to muscle memory. Taking a break? 👇

Gym Myths Busted #3
first_comment: Who else got told "all that muscle will turn to fat" by their uncle? 😂
